omapi_port.description: Port number on which the OMAPI server listens for connections. Must match client/tool configuration (e.g., 'omshell').

omapi_key_name.description: Identifier name for the OMAPI authentication key. Used in the 'omapi-key' directive and must match client key references.

omapi_key_algorithm.description: Cryptographic algorithm for the OMAPI authentication key. Common values: 'hmac-sha256', 'hmac-sha512', 'hmac-sha384', 'hmac-sha224'.

omapi_key_secret.description: Base64-encoded secret used for OMAPI authentication. Must be a secure, randomly generated value.

omapi_allow_list.description: List of allowed IP addresses or CIDR ranges permitted to connect to the OMAPI server.

items.description: Allowed host (IP address, CIDR, or 'any' for wildcard — use with caution).

omapi_deny_list.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges explicitly denied access to the OMAPI server. Deny rules take precedence over allow.
